_doctrine: R-023: the baseline contract. Deck 1 BEATS = what a PLAIN tutorial on this concept would minimally need (derived from the concept, not the inventory); each beat is a ROLE cast with one artifact (alts = understudies). Deck 2 VOLTAGE = the few pieces a plain tutorial would never include -- the critical script, the thinker with QFEP. Everything uncast is AT DEPTH: kept, honored by the dig line, not needed by the book or the walk.

beats.role: the graph under the maps — the substrate

voltage.after: the graph under the maps — the substrate
voltage.why: Deleuze-Guattari's rhizome — the network that refuses root, trunk, leaf; the substrate that was always under every map, non-hierarchical, entering from anywhere (the QFEP turn on 'structure')
the network as power and passage — Euler's seven bridges; who may cross to whom, the city as a walkable proof that some routes are foreclosed by structure itself
the optimized route as ideology — the fastest path is a choice about what to skip; the efficiency critique, what the shortest path forecloses (every node it never visits)
maximum matching as who-gets-to-touch-whom — pairing as a contested allocation; adjacency is never neutral, the graph decides who may be joined
